purpose: Source evidence only; never import into training or deployment. Bodies retain source names. New implementation must use the naming map.

entries.notes: Capture concat+fc+hidden_norm and model forward; only the context operations will be migrated.
Static per-draft-layer fusion; dedicated context projections; preserve initialization and ordering.
MHA uses equal query/KV heads; upstream also supports grouped heads, outside first-version registry.
Existing expanded-KV MLA; do not present this source as the original DeepSeek implementation.
Preserve residual/norm/conv order; kernel scheduling is separate from mathematical structure.
Inference reference shifts along its sequence; multi-anchor training must preserve framework block isolation.
Block-local training layout and identity initialization reference.
Contains legacy block-causal SWA; keep as evidence, do not copy its sliding semantics into the new implementation.
Additive full-vocabulary correction and sequential proposal conditioning.
Preserve joint state/embedding/hidden projection, output branch, teacher prefix and state reset.
Top-K support with predecessor-conditioned walk, not global Viterbi.
Keep unary main objective plus covered candidate CE; BV+selector unsupported.
Replacement logits head, not additive; source is LiteSpec project implementation.
Hard labels and numerator only; outer reduction is a separate contract.
Target-to-draft KL with frozen teacher and unchanged softmax/precision boundaries.
Standard TV; do not confuse with framework L1=2*TV.
Retain as a scale reference; no changes to legacy algorithm paths.
Public Speculators reference, not an assertion that this is the LK paper authors code.
Preserve per-sample valid-mask denominator then sample mean, including epsilon; decay enters numerator only.
Reference includes native weight computation and forward reduction / float(bsz). Generic training preparation is not to be copied into composable.
Reuse these operations, with per-objective eligibility and untouched logical N/A/B.
Literal indented method excerpts; these methods are not top-level executable code. Identify eligibility and frozen embedding preparation only.
Existing single differentiable numerator and additive detached denominator.
Runner backpropagates numerator/accumulation_steps and normalizes gradients once per optimizer window.
Do not pre-divide D-PACE numerator and then let this function divide by N again.
Explicit adapter whitelist must be extended later; this task does not modify it.
draft_model.* parameter extraction and old flat export path; preserve legacy behavior.
Current dependency collector only accepts flat sibling imports; composable needs its own export path.
Runtime YAML/JSON path reuse; do not hand nested dictionaries to flat arguments_to_cli.
Qwen3.5-specific separate qkv/z/b/a projections, causal convolution, gate/norm order, PyTorch reference paths. Not Qwen3-Next's packed projections.
Historical hybrid cache contract; recurrent_states is the actual attribute (some upstream prose says ssm_states). Not a crop-compatible speculative cache implementation.
Official gated full-attention branch, pre-norm/residual/MLP ordering and initialization; supporting helpers stay in full source. Existing MHA is not asserted equivalent.
Linear-attention dimensions and configurable layer_types; default 3 linear layers + 1 full layer. This source baseline is distinct from the separately pinned Hub checkpoint config.
